ledger.content: Static axial metric ansatz ds6^2 = exp(2A(r)) gbar_munu dx^mu dx^nu + dr^2 + L(r)^2 dchi^2 with Rbar_munu = 3 K4 gbar_munu.
A0 is reported as a constant-scalar de-Sitter branch, with a commonly cited potential convention V(phi)=Lambda6+beta phi^2 and beta>=0.
ledger.source_status: summary/provenance available; exact historical action line not recovered

ledger.content: At K4=beta=1 the reported A0 benchmark set is sqrt(K4) rho_cap=1.1196329253611, kappa6^2 lambda_eff/(4 sqrt(K4))=0.8931498683204, K4 rho_cap^2=1.2535778875527, V_W=0.5318111250097, R_circle=0.6661500466003 and Xi_cap approximately 0.9999999998535.
ledger.source_status: repeated consistently in archive audit and repository diagnostics

ledger.content: The A0 background is described as analytically closed with a reported numerical reproduction.
ledger.source_status: archive audit report available; equations and executable solver absent

ledger.content: The physical radius distinction R_circle != rho_cap approximately R_K is part of the archived interpretation.
The A0 point is not weakly curved because K4 rho_cap^2 approximately 1.2536 is not much smaller than one.
ledger.validity: applies to the reported A0 normalization point

ledger.content: MD-2S-B1.4N reports that the unrestricted linear system is algebraically solvable using a conical centre mode, while no global solution exists with fixed smooth centre and only minimal cap controls.
An additional independent geometric control is required before the B1.4O response-rank audit can be executed.
ledger.source_status: archive audit and repository recovery profile

ledger.content: The exact historical independent radial ODE set, Hamiltonian constraint and algebraic dependency map are unavailable in the accessible indexed corpus.
The exact historical cap/localized action and oriented junction conventions are unavailable.
The definitions and integration conventions for V_W, R_circle, Xi_cap and lambda_eff are not all available as primary equations.
The current SCI-001/SCI-002 files define a later Einstein-Maxwell-scalar parent skeleton with GHY and cap/brane structure, but model identity with the historical A0 solver has not been established.
blocks: using A0 numbers as mandatory current-model predictions

ledger.content: The COS-01.1 lapse-preserving minisuperspace equations describe homogeneous time evolution of a(t) and b(t), not the static radial MD-2S cap BVP.
ledger.forbidden_use: substitution for missing MD-2S radial equations

ledger.content: Statements that a ghost-free region exists are at most scoped to tested reduced sectors; full scalar-vector-tensor and HZT-Full ghost freedom remain open.

The directly inspected Zip_analysis_pack.zip contains 141 conversations, including 69 Hyperzeit-classified conversations, but its latest update is 2025-12-17 and it contains no message-text occurrence of MD-2S, B1.4N, B1.4O or the registered A0 benchmark values.
ledger.implication: This archive predates the 2026 MD-2S calculation and cannot close the historical solver gap.

ledger.content: The uploaded MD-0 v3.0 Constitution confirms the governance hierarchy, Forward Engine requirement and prohibition on interpreting proxy fits or data paths as evidence before the physical forward map exists.
MD-2F, MD-2H and MD-2I define the downstream P_phys to P_mod bridge audit and keep K1-D locked. They do not provide the missing MD-2S background action, radial equations or cap boundary data.
ledger.implication: The bridge documents constrain the use of the eventual background solution but cannot substitute for its derivation.

ledger.content: The uploaded GW dossier uses a different static warp ansatz ds^2=exp(-2A0)eta_munu dx^mu dx^nu+exp(2B0)dr^2+exp(2C0)r^2 dtheta^2 and studies a linear dipole/Kalb-Ramond sector. It is not equation-identical to the MD-2S background ansatz without an explicit coordinate and model mapping.
ledger.forbidden_use: using the GW dossier operator statements as the missing MD-2S radial background equations

ledger.content: The bridge normalization skeleton 1/kappa4^2=(1/kappa6^2) integral d^2y sqrt(g2) exp(2A) shows that a reproduced MD-2S warped volume can harden the kappa6-to-4D normalization edge, while the internal eigenvalue problem m_n^2=lambda_n/R_chi^2 can harden the R_chi-to-m edge.

recommended_decision.decision: Maintain separate legacy-reproduction, current-canonical-rebuild and GW-phenomenology model IDs until equation-level identity and forward-map bridges are proven.
recommended_decision.reason: This prevents benchmark fitting, downstream bridge parametrization or GW phenomenology from silently defining the missing MD-2S parent theory.
